free_tier.stated: No free tier read. Access is a token bought by duration; the captured pages state no amount, so no price is recorded.
free_tier.notes: The price is the vendor's plan rate for the subscription whose exits are classified here; the exit-address measurement itself has no price.

per_object_cap.notes: The classified sample is 36 addresses over 14 ASNs; none of those numbers is an object size.

retention.stated: not applicable: an address, not an object
retention.notes: Nothing is stored, so no retention clock applies. How long one exit address is held before it is re-drawn was not observed.

egress.terms: unverified: no traffic allowance or per-GB price appears in the captured pages; metered is recorded false because no metered charge was read.

interface_detail: The server list at https://cryptostorm.is/configs/ is the source of the exit addresses classified here. The schema interface enum has no token for a VPN tunnel, so the tunnel protocols are not recorded as an interface.
tooling: The exit addresses are read from https://cryptostorm.is/configs/ and classified with an IP-class detector; the service itself is reached with the vendor's own client or a WireGuard or OpenVPN configuration.
chaining: A Worker or a free compute node dials the tunnel and the traffic leaves at one of these exit addresses, so the upstream sees an address in the ASNs listed here and not the caller's network.

limits.value: token duration sets the device limit: a one year token allows 4 WireGuard keys and 4 OpenVPN sessions

binding_note: No limit kind binds the record: it measures exit addresses and states no byte quota or request rate. What matters is list membership: 35 of 36 sampled exits are on a datacenter list.

identity_cost.detail: Tokens are delivered in the browser, and only recurring PayPal or CCBill subscribers get a token by email; the FAQ advises cryptocurrency and a disposable email for more anonymity. Whether the purchase form asks for an email is unverified.

reliability_note: 35 of 36 sampled exit addresses are on a datacenter list and 23 of 36 on a VPN list, so a site that blocks those lists blocks most of this fleet; 0 of 36 are also on an abuse list.
confidence_note: The list membership, ASN spread and counts are measured: each address was answered by the detector at the stated index version. The plan price and the identity class are documented from the vendor's captured pages; where a page did not state them they are unverified. The sample is the addresses the vendor endpoint returned, not proof that every address a user is handed is in it.

evidence.proved: The vendor endpoint https://cryptostorm.is/configs/ gave 36 IPv4 exit addresses, each answered by the address-class detector at index version 20261103T163900Z-00d117b2 on 2026-11-03. Datacenter list: 35 of 36; VPN list: 23 of 36 (23 in the x4b VPN list); abuse list: 0 of 36; on none of the three: 1 of 36. 14 distinct ASNs and 36 distinct /24s; largest ASN AS9009 M247 M247 Europe SRL with 23 addresses.
Detector index version 20261103T163900Z-00d117b2 was the one every one of the 36 answers carries.
token duration sets the device limit; a one year token allows 4 WireGuard keys and 4 OpenVPN sessions

evidence.quote: Around February of 2024 we changed the delivery setup where now only people who have a recurring subscription (via PayPal or CCBill) get their tokens delivered by email.
evidence.proved: the token is delivered in the browser unless the buyer holds a recurring subscription

notes: List membership of 36 exit addresses (detector index version 20261103T163900Z-00d117b2, 2026-11-03): datacenter 35, VPN 23, abuse 0, none of the three 1. VPN list: 23 of 36, of which 23 are in the x4b VPN list. Definitions: datacenter is an address inside a range the x4b datacenter list publishes; VPN is inside the x4b VPN list or a per-provider server list; abuse is on at least one independent abuse family; none of the three states list membership, not physical siting.

extras.rung_note: Addresses came from the vendor's own server list and each was classified; no exit was connected to, so the address a user is handed at connect time was not observed.
